## How this file works

**Two rules, and they are the whole point:**

1. **A box is ticked only when its evidence is pasted** into that stage's Evidence log.
   Not when the code looks right. Not when the command *should* pass. When you have run it
   and pasted what it actually printed.
2. **A stage writes only its own section.** Stages run in parallel; this file is append-only
   per section so two sessions never clobber each other.

After ticking anything, run `pnpm checkpoints` to regenerate the header.

**Status key:** ⬜ not started · 🟡 in progress · ✅ done · ⛔ blocked

If something is blocked — no API key, no browser, no Meta approval — mark it **⛔ and say
why**. A stage at 80% with an honest blocker is more useful than one reported done that
isn't.

## Wave gates

A wave does not open until the previous gate passes. Tick the gate after its wave's stages.

- [ ] **W0 gate** — contracts frozen, every port has a mock proven by test, `pnpm build` passes from a clean clone
- [ ] **W1 gate** — `pnpm typecheck` passes across all packages
- [ ] **W2 gate** — real implementations swapped for mocks; port conformance tests pass
- [ ] **W3 gate** — one end-to-end run against a live Atlas dev DB
- [ ] **W4 gate** — deployed, evals green, baseline stored
